policy: Reviewed anonymous employer recruiting routes that need a more specific list entry than the generic registry seed. No login, applicant, resume-upload or private endpoints are allowed. Optional detail_url_template values must be observed public job-detail routes and may interpolate only the public position {id}.

sources.evidence: Verified 2026-08-25 against Kuaishou's anonymous public positions/simple API: project 20271779425607 reports 271 released positions. The generic campus SPA resets project/page hash state, so this reviewed source uses the same public API directly and checks collected count against reported total.

Verified 2026-08-25 against Kuaishou's anonymous public positions/simple API: project 20271772783534 reports 228 released positions. The dedicated adapter paginates the public API and fails closed if unique collected positions do not equal the reported total.

Verified 2026-08-25 in a real anonymous Chrome session: the official social SPA successfully requests public positions/simple pages 2, 50 and 140 when only its public pageNum hash changes; the live catalogue was about 1.4k positions and the social job-info/{id} route was previously browser-verified. Direct requests outside the employer SPA return an application error, so this reviewed adapter keeps the employer's own UI/XHR transport and never exports cookie values or reproduces request signatures.

Verified 2026-08-25 from the employer's visible 日常实习 navigation: the current route is /official/trainee/ (not the obsolete /official/intern/). The official SPA successfully emits unfiltered public XHR for page 1, page 2 and page 111 with a live total of 1110. The concrete public route /official/trainee/job-info/32303 was opened in anonymous Chrome and rendered the matching position title, location, update date, description and requirements, validating the job-info/{id} detail template.
JD's current employer-owned recruiting home renders live job rows and links to social/campus/intern recruiting sections.
